messages.subject: Signing logistics — 28 April
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

For Monday's signing: we'll use e-signature for both parties. I'll circulate the execution version for signature first thing Monday morning, with Rebecca signing for Harrow and Catherine Mowbray for Stratton. Aiming to have everything dated and exchanged by mid-afternoon.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant, Whitfield Carter LLP
